newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Port conditions update - Sri Lanka - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Sri Lanka - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

SRI LANKA, Oct 22 - Colombo - Nine container dischargers, four food dischargers, two cement dischargers, three fertilizer dischargers, two general cargo dischargers, one gas discharger and three general cargo loaders presently working in port. One food discharger, two general cargo dischargers, two steel dischargers and one cement discharger awaiting berths.
